
'''Kabutozuka Kofun''' (甲塚古墳)

== Kabutozuka Kofun (甲塚古墳) ==

* {{ill|Kabutozuka Kofun (Iwaki)|ja|甲塚古墳 (いわき市)|qid=Q17990175|lt=Kabutozuka Kofun (Iwaki)}} - An ancient Kofun in Iwaki City, Fukushima Prefecture, designated as a national historic site.
* {{ill|Kabutozuka Kofun (Shimotsuke)|ja|甲塚古墳 (下野市)|qid=Q30925678}} - An ancient Kofun in Shimotsuke City, Tochigi Prefecture.
* {{ill|Kabutozuka Kofun (Kyoto)|ja|甲塚古墳 (京都市)|qid=Q115858640}} - An ancient Kofun in Kyoto City, Kyoto Prefecture.
* {{ill|Kabutozuka Kofun (Ikaruga)|ja|甲塚古墳 (斑鳩町)}} - An ancient Kofun in Ikaruga Town, Nara Prefecture.
* {{ill|Hikodoku Kabutozuka Kofun|ja|彦徳甲塚古墳}} - An ancient Kofun in Miyako Town, Fukuoka Prefecture, designated as a Fukuoka Prefectural Historic Site.
* {{ill|Kabutozuka Square Mound|ja|甲塚方墳}} - An ancient Kofun in Miyako Town, Fukuoka Prefecture, designated as a Miyako Town Historic Site.

== {{ill|Kabutozuka Kofun|ja|兜塚古墳|qid=Q112658153}} (兜塚古墳) ==
'''Kabutozuka Kofun''' (兜塚古墳)

* {{ill|Kabutozuka Kofun (Sendai)|ja|兜塚古墳 (仙台市)}} - A kofun (ancient Kofun) located in Sendai City, Miyagi Prefecture.  
* Kabutozuka Kofun (Komae) - A kofun located in Komae City, Tokyo. Designated as a historic site by Tokyo. See {{ill|Komae Kofun Cluster|ja|狛江古墳群|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q111804227}} for reference.  
* {{ill|Kabutozuka Kofun (Yokohama)|ja|兜塚古墳 (横浜市)}} - A kofun that once existed in Yokohama City, Kanagawa Prefecture.  
* {{ill|Kabutozuka Kofun (Sakurai)|ja|兜塚古墳 (桜井市)}} - A kofun located in Sakurai City, Nara Prefecture. Designated as a historic site by Sakurai City.  
* Kabutozuka Kofun (Fukuoka) - A kofun located in Fukuoka City, Fukuoka Prefecture. Designated as a National [[:en:Historic Sites of Japan|Historic Site]]. See {{ill|Imajuku Kofun Group|ja|今宿古墳群|qid=Q103946619}} for reference.
